original_test_intent: Confirm that OAM_4's sensor set and current health are reported correctly and consistently by SMC Redfish, IPMI, ROCm and BMC Web.
original_method: Map each OAM_4 physical sensor across the four views, collect in a controlled window, record source update times/cadence, normalize unit and health semantics, then compare against approved limits and tolerances.
manual_activity: GPU thermal owner supplies OAM_4 mappings/cadence/tolerance and confirms UI evidence and final disposition.
required_inputs: OAM_4 sensor population and cross-interface names
Per-source update cadence and maximum sample age/skew
Secure Redfish/DUT access and pinned tools
safety_requirements: Record source timestamps without repeated polling to force equality
Stop on unapproved mapping or missing unit
agent_execution_scope: Capture all four OAM_4 observation surfaces
Normalize using approved mapping and cadence rules
engineer_actions: Approve sensor crosswalk and sampling contract

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It targets the relevant Redfish member but omits mandatory IPMI/ROCm/Web evidence and uses insecure access.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely capture OAM_4 Redfish, IPMI, ROCm and Web values with source-specific timestamps and reconcile them using approved cadence, unit and tolerance rules.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The OAM_4 multi-interface scope and 5/5-minute estimates are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For each OAM_4 sensor, retain raw source timestamp/value/status, derive age and normalized unit, then compare only samples valid under the approved cadence/skew policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds defensible temporal alignment to the original generic cross-check.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Does not test sensor response under induced load or OAM_4 power-consumption accuracy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: If an interface lacks timestamps, the capture time and documented refresh cadence are only a bounded proxy.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must approve OAM_4 Web cache interval and each source's refresh cadence before a difference is labeled erroneous.
expected_evidence: OAM_4 identity and physical sensor crosswalk
Redacted raw Redfish/IPMI/ROCm outputs with capture times
Logs, anomaly decisions, cleanup and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires all OAM_4 interfaces; DeepSeek's partial command is not alternate authoritative coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Secure tools, mappings and owner confirmation remain supplyable prerequisites.

review_improvement: Introduces source-cadence and sample-age controls so legitimate asynchronous reporting and stale cache are distinguishable.
independent_technical_reasoning: BMC, IPMI, ROCm and Web often refresh from different polling loops. Two different values can both be correct if their sample ages differ, while identical values can be wrong if one surface is frozen. Recording update cadence and age for OAM_4 therefore provides stronger evidence than simply polling until all displays coincide.
